storage_check.title: Check the database file
storage_check.description: Check that the SQLite file holds no orphaned component row and no reference to an entity that does not exist. Neither shows up in a query, since every read starts from the entity table, so this asks the connection directly: whether foreign keys are enforced, which rows violate one, and what SQLite’s own integrity_check reports.

archetype_check.title: Check the archetype pointers
archetype_check.description: Check that every archetype pointer matches the components its entity has. A writer that inserts rows without going through the graph, and without updating the archetypes of the entities it touched, leaves stale pointers that both reads and the query planner rely on.
